description: City of Port Phillip Asset Data is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Port Phillip. Includes current instances for some of the classes within the City of Port Phillip asset system. Although all due care has been taken to ensure that these data are correct, no warranty is expressed or implied by the City of Port Phillip in their use. Coverage: City of Port Phillip. The portal files it under the publisher City of Port Phillip. Its tags are asset, civil infrastructure. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-08-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share Alike 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
